name: Stefan Kohler
bio:
Stefan Kohler's precision and organizational skills are the backbone of his approach to motorsport operations. Growing up in a small village nestled in the Swiss Alps, Stefan developed a deep appreciation for engineering and problem-solving. His journey into motorsport began with karting, quickly realizing his passion lay in the meticulous details of race preparation rather than the thrill of driving itself. 

After earning a degree in engineering, Stefan honed his skills managing logistics and technical support for smaller racing teams, gaining invaluable experience in optimizing resources and streamlining processes. Stefan joined MP Motorsport eager to contribute his expertise in operational efficiency. He is driven by a desire to create a seamless and highly effective team environment, always seeking innovative solutions to improve performance both on and off the track.

What sets Stefan apart is his ability to remain calm and collected under pressure. He has a knack for anticipating potential issues and implementing proactive measures to mitigate risks. His pragmatic approach ensures that every decision is grounded in practicality and contributes to the overall success of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side
physical.description: Stefan is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.
